title: eXc Timer
description: A lightweight on-screen stopwatch for Minecraft. Control it with chat commands, watch the time in a turquoise to purple gradient, and keep your progress saved per world.
body:
# eXc Timer

A simple, clean on-screen stopwatch for Minecraft. Track your time directly on
the HUD, control it with chat commands, and pick up right where you left off —
the timer is saved per world.

## Features

- **Clean HUD timer** centered above the hotbar, with a smooth
  turquoise-to-purple gradient.
- **Adaptive time format** — only the units you need:
  - `12sec`
  - `3min 5sec`
  - `2h 3min 5sec`
  - `1d 2h 3min 5sec`
- **Chat commands** to control everything:
  - `/timer start` — start counting from zero
  - `/timer pause` — pause the timer
  - `/timer unpause` — resume
  - `/timer reset` — reset to zero
  - `/timer hide` — hide the timer
  - `/timer show` — show the timer
- **Per-world saving** — your time is stored per world (and per server) and
  restored automatically when you rejoin.
